module: The rally "Recce" app in freeroam: lets you load a rally mission (rallyStage, rallyStageLoop or rallyRoadSection of the current level), display the upcoming pacenotes, teleport the vehicle along the pacenotes, to the start or to the mission trigger, and record a recce (vehicle driveline and voice "cuts"). Also provides a "Recce Toolbox" imgui window drawn in onUpdate. Relies on gameplay_rally (loadMission, getRallyManager, canManageMission), RecceSettings, VehicleCapture and CutCapture. Does nothing in onUpdate until setEnabled(true) has been called.
usage:
extensions.load('gameplay_rally_recceApp')
gameplay_rally_recceApp.openWindow()
-- then, in the window or in Lua:
gameplay_rally_recceApp.recordDrivelineStart(false)
gameplay_rally_recceApp.recordDrivelineCut()
gameplay_rally_recceApp.recordDrivelineStop()
notes: The recordings (VehicleCapture / CutCapture) are only created if the game state is "freeroam" and the rally manager has a mission folder; otherwise vehicleCapture and cutCapture stay nil.

Potential bug: recordDrivelineClearAll calls vehicleCapture:truncateCapturesFile() without testing that initCaptures actually created the captures; outside freeroam or without a loaded mission, this raises an error on nil.

recordDrivelineCut only transcribes the voice if recordVoice was passed as true to recordDrivelineStart; if extensions.gameplay_rally_client.transcribe_recording_cut fails, the UI hook rallyInputActionDesktopCallNotOk receives the client message.

moveVehicleToPacenoteV2 (used by moveVehicleForward/Backward) looks for the closest corner start via a kd-tree; if the vehicle is less than 12 m (10 + 2) from a pacenote, it goes to the next or the previous one, otherwise to the closest. It places the vehicle 10 m before the pacenote on the driveline.
The code contains a commented-out block of code (idea of an all-imgui app) with no effect.
UI events emitted: rally.recceApp.missionLoaded (success, error message), rally.recceApp.refreshed (list of missions, last state), rallyInputActionDesktopCallNotOk.

onUpdate.desc: Extension hook called every frame: if the app is enabled, draws the pacenotes (or the short route), the imgui window if open, and captures the vehicle position during driveline recording.

reload.desc: Reloads the RecceSettings, rebuilds the level's list of rally missions and sends the UI hook rally.recceApp.refreshed with {missions, last_mission_id, last_load_state, can_auto_load, corner_angles_style}.

rallyExt.desc: Not used in the function body

loadMission.desc: Loads a mission via gameplay_rally.loadMission (owner 'recce'), builds the kd-tree index of the notebook's corner starts, stores the mission and the load state, then sends rally.recceApp.missionLoaded.

returns.desc: true if the mission is loaded

unloadMission.desc: Unloads the mission of the 'recce' owner and stores the load state as false.

returns.desc: false if the unload is refused

release.desc: Disables the app, closes the window, forgets the captures and unloads the mission if it belongs to 'recce'.

setLastMissionId.desc: Stores in the settings the last mission id for the current level.

setLastLoadState.desc: Stores in the settings the last load state (true/false) for the current level.

state.desc: true if a mission was loaded

setShowNotes.desc: Enables or disables the display of the next pacenotes while driving (outside the active editor and when the rally toolbox is not visible).

moveVehicleBackward.desc: Teleports the player vehicle to the previous pacenote (or the closest if far from any pacenote), then resyncs the rally manager.

moveVehicleForward.desc: Teleports the player vehicle to the next pacenote (or the closest if far from any pacenote), then resyncs the rally manager.

moveVehicleToStart.desc: Teleports the player vehicle to the race path's default start position (orientation flipped by 180°), then resyncs the rally manager.

moveVehicleToMission.desc: Teleports the player vehicle to the mission's start trigger (pos, rot), then resyncs the rally manager.

recordDrivelineCut.desc: Records a cut at the vehicle's current position (CutCapture) and, if voice recording is enabled, requests the transcription from the rally client.

recordDrivelineStart.desc: Starts the driveline recording: initializes the captures (recce folders created if needed) and enables per-frame capture.

recordVoice.desc: true to also transcribe the voice at each cut

recordDrivelineStop.desc: Stops the recording: writes the vehicle captures to disk then forgets the captures.

recordDrivelineClearAll.desc: Clears the mission's recording files: driveline, cuts and transcripts (file truncation).

isRecording.desc: Indicates whether a driveline recording is in progress.

setEnabled.desc: Enables or disables the app; onUpdate does nothing if it is disabled.

isEnabled.desc: Indicates whether the app is enabled.

openWindow.desc: Enables the app, opens the "Recce Toolbox" imgui window and refreshes the mission list.

closeWindow.desc: Closes the imgui window (without disabling the app).

toggleWindow.desc: Opens the window if it is closed, closes it otherwise.

isWindowVisible.desc: Indicates whether the imgui window is open.

toggleMouseLikeVehicle.desc: Toggles the rally toolbox's move-vehicle-with-mouse checkbox, if it exists.
